draft.body:
The queue-with-backoff approach fits the ticket: deliveries are stored, retried for 24 hours and visible to the customer. One thing blocks the merge and two should be fixed with it.

### Open — needs a decision

| | Where | Finding | Status |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| 🔴 Blocker · F1 | [`DeliverWebhook.php:58`](https://github.com/acme/portal/blob/3f9c2ab/jobs/DeliverWebhook.php#L58) | A retried delivery is sent without an idempotency key | Open · on the code |
| 🟠 Should · F2 | [the pull request](https://github.com/acme/portal/pull/412) | No way to replay a delivery after the window closes | Open · in the body |
| 🟠 Should · F3 | [`WebhookRetryTest.php:31`](https://github.com/acme/portal/blob/3f9c2ab/tests/WebhookRetryTest.php#L31) | The failure test passes with the retry code reverted | Open · in the body |

### Should · F2 · No way to replay a delivery after the window closes

After 24 hours a failed delivery is marked dead and nothing can send it again. Acceptance criterion 3 on ABC-231 asks for the customer to recover from a long outage.

### Should · F3 · The failure test passes with the retry code reverted

I reverted the retry and `tests/WebhookRetryTest.php:31` still passed, so it does not pin the behaviour.

**Not checked:** worker behaviour across a deploy restart; production delivery volumes.

threads.title: A retried delivery is sent without an idempotency key
threads.body:
> [!CAUTION]
> **Blocker · F1** — A retried delivery is sent without an idempotency key · `Open`
>
> A retry re-sends the same payload with no key, so a customer whose endpoint accepted the first attempt slowly receives the event twice. See `jobs/DeliverWebhook.php:58`.
>
> ```mermaid
> flowchart LR
>   A[Attempt 1 times out] --> B[Endpoint still processes it]
>   B --> C[Attempt 2 sends again]
>   C --> D[Two events for one]
> ```
>
> <details>
> <summary>Proof: throwaway test, 2 deliveries for 1 event</summary>
>
> ```php
> $event = Event::factory()->create();
> Http::fake(['*' => Http::sequence()->pushStatus(504)->pushStatus(200)]);
> DeliverWebhook::dispatchSync($event);
> $this->artisan('queue:work --once');
> // 2 requests, same payload, no Idempotency-Key header on either
> $this->assertCount(2, Http::recorded());
> ```
>
> </details>

<!-- review-desk:F1 -->
